summary.text: Candy Spence Ezzell is a Republican who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2025, representing District 32 in Chaves and Eddy counties.
The legislature's member page lists Ezzell as a representative from 2005 to 2024, and as ranking member of the Senate Conservation Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Ezzell's occupation as rancher and a district office in Roswell.
Ezzell also sits on the Senate Education Committee and, between sessions, on the Legislative Education Study Committee and the Water and Natural Resources Committee.
